properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is a timing side-channel vulnerability where MAC/digest comparisons use regular equality operators instead of constant-time comparison functions, potentially leaking information about the values being compared through timing variations.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 is used in hybrid KEM configurations (ML-KEM768 + X25519) which provides post-quantum security by combining classical and quantum-safe algorithms. However, X25519 alone is vulnerable to Shor's algorithm.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Used in hybrid.test.ts for signature verification and signing operations. This is classical cryptography that will be broken by Shor's algorithm.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Used in hybrid.ts for signature verification and signing operations with Weierstrass curves. This is classical cryptography that will be broken by Shor's algorithm.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is used for digital signatures in the project, but it is a classical algorithm vulnerable to quantum attacks. It needs migration to post-quantum signature schemes like ML-DSA or SLH-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256 is used for digital signatures in the project, but it is a classical algorithm vulnerable to quantum attacks. It needs migration to post-quantum signature schemes like ML-DSA or SLH-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-384 and P-521 curves are used in hybrid KEM configurations (ML-KEM1024 + P-384) which provides post-quantum security by combining classical and quantum-safe algorithms. However, the curves alone are vulnerable to Shor's algorithm.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ML-KEM is a post-quantum KEM algorithm (FIPS 203) used for key exchange in hybrid configurations with classical algorithms like X25519 to provide quantum-safe communication.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ML-DSA is a post-quantum DSA algorithm (FIPS 204) used for digital signatures in hybrid configurations to provide quantum-safe signing capabilities.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SLH-DSA is a stateless hash-based signature algorithm (FIPS 205) used for digital signatures providing quantum-safe signing capabilities.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: FN-DSA/Falcon is a post-quantum signature algorithm (FIPS 206, draft) used for digital signatures providing quantum-safe signing capabilities.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 is used in the project for non-cryptographic purposes like cache keys or checksums, where quantum resistance is not required.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Kyber is a post-quantum KEM algorithm used for key exchange providing quantum-safe communication (though it's a pre-standard version).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-GCM is used for symmetric encryption in the project and provides data confidentiality but is not quantum-safe - it's a classical algorithm vulnerable to Shor's algorithm.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is the main post-quantum cryptography library that implements hybrid schemes combining classical and quantum-safe algorithms. It contains ML-KEM, ML-DSA, Falcon, etc. While it's a PQC library, the classical components (ECDSA, Ed25519) are still vulnerable to quantum attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/ciphers is a cryptographic library available in the project and contains classical cipher implementations (like AES-GCM) that are not quantum-safe but are used for data confidentiality purposes.
